cohort.scope: First chapter only, first three shops including initial shop, no seed reselection
cohort.policy: Same cheapest affordable scoring-hook offer, ties shelf position; at most 2 purchases per shop, no duplicate, capacity bound; once reroll only if no affordable scoring offer and gold >= cost+4; optional T01 after core purchases with 2 gold reserve, upgrade most actually played discovered type (ties R2 directory); hand existing chooseR2Action max conservative visible score; if below remaining/hands and no preferred f09 intact qualification, discard noncore up to5, high-card keeps two highest points; Touye wager only last hand, nonwager cannot clear but public wager maximum can. No predicted future deck/RNG, no injection/sale/ideal-card search; no programme choice, use existing default.

limitations: 18 fixed small diagnostic runs are not a win-rate estimate.
One transparent one-step strategy; no long-term planning or all-item strategy optimization.
The same purchase policy can buy currently inapplicable conditions; record them, do not cherry-pick.
Program choices left to existing default; actual rewards included.
No renderer, physical GPU, audio or human-experience validation.
